title: Apple cake
hookLine: Netherlands-inspired apple cake with 9 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Apple cake
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat the oven to 180°C. (350˚F) Grease a cake pan and line it with baking paper. In a large bowl, break the four eggs with the sugar and beat until they have tripled in volume and become fluffy. Sift the self-rising baking flour and add it to your egg mixture. Fold this over, preserving as much air as possible. Add the melted (and slightly cooled) butter and mix until combined. Incorporate {m53380_1}, {m53380_2}, {m53380_3}, and {m53380_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure eggs first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Apple cake
steps.instructionTemplate: Add cinnamon, pinch of salt and vanilla extract. Add the diced apple to the batter and gently fold them into the batter so that the apple pieces are evenly distributed. You can roll the apple pieces through some more cinnamon. Pour the batter into the prepared cake pan and smooth the top with a spatula. Incorporate {m53380_5}, {m53380_6}, {m53380_7}, {m53380_8}, and {m53380_9} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Apple cake
steps.instructionTemplate: Place the apple slices on top of the batter and press lightly. Sprinkle optionally with some almond shavings. Bake the apple cake in the preheated oven for about 45-50 minutes, or until a wooden skewer comes out clean when inserted into the center of the cake. Remove the cake from the oven and let it cool in the mold for a few minutes. Then carefully remove the cake from the mold and let cool completely on a wire rack.

steps.title: Bake / Chill: Apple cake
steps.instructionTemplate: Sprinkle the cooled apple cake with powdered sugar. Let Apple cake cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 6 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Wait until the sponge feels cool to the touch before frosting so your glaze or cream stays thick and glossy.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
